bureau: Credit Registry of Kosovo (Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo)
note: The Central Bank of Kosovo's Regulation on Credit Registry, article 5(2)(b): the registry may not report data on a credit repaid more than five years after its full repayment (seven after a write-off). No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo, Regulation on Credit Registry
sources.said: The data on returned credits after five years following the date of complete return, and the data on credits deleted from the balance, after seven years following the date of deletion.
